criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 18 November 2028 (24 months after the 18 November 2026 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.

Identifies that the board approval was given at a meeting with only 2 directors present when Article 11 requires a quorum of three, so the approval may be invalid, and recommends a fresh or ratifying resolution.

Identifies that the MAC carve-outs (general economic, industry-wide and pandemic changes) contain no 'disproportionate effect' exception, so the Buyer bears those risks even where the Company is disproportionately affected, and recommends adding one.
Gives the escrow release period as a duration (24 months) and as a date (18 November 2028), with days remaining from 30 September 2026 (780 days).
Notes that 18 November 2028 is a Saturday and that the release moves to the next Business Day, 20 November 2028.
Expressly flags inconsistencies between documents (amounts, dates, periods or defined terms that differ across documents).
